fichas.h1_agente: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano
fichas.h1_seo: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano
fichas.descripcion_agente:
This Rugiano coffee table has a shaped top in marble or Decoro decorated painted wood, carried on two bronzed brass legs. Made in Italy.

MARBLE OR WOOD

Pick the marble table for a top from a wide range of marbles, or the wood table with its Decoro decorated painted finish. Both share the same shaped profile and low height.

LEGS AND SIZES

The two legs are bronzed brass metal. It comes in two sizes; check the length against your sofa before you order. See all coffee tables.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Rock is a Rugiano coffee table with an irregular, pebble-like top resting on two bronzed brass legs. Made in Italy.
TWO TOPS, TWO LOOKS
 • Marble table top in 19 marbles, from Travertino and Emperador Dark (category A) to Calacatta Gold (B) and Patagonia or Calcite St Barth (C).
 • A hand-painted wood table top in Rugiano's Decoro technique, with 11 designs inspired by painters such as Van Gogh, Monet and Botticelli.
WHICH SIZE
 The three large sizes are 11" high, for a low sofa. The small one (size C) is 14 1/8" high and works as a side table next to an armchair.

fichas.h1_seo: Club Sofa with Brass Tube Frame by Rugiano
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Club couch is a Rugiano sofa with a structure of brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes. Made in Italy.

TUBES AND UPHOLSTERY

The upholstery and the drawn tubes together create the pattern that distinguishes this club style sofa.

  • Brushed brass drawn tubes.
  • Bronze drawn tubes.
  • Leather upholstery.
  • Fabric upholstery.

Choose the metal for the tubes and the cover for the upholstery; the Club is designed for a living area. Explore more sofas and sectionals.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
A club style sofa with straight lines and a frame of brushed brass or bronze tubes that outline the upholstery. If you are comparing Rugiano sofas, this is the one where the metal frame is the design.
FITS MORE ROOMS THAN IT LOOKS
 At 33 1/2" deep, this club couch is shallower than most luxury sofas. That makes it a good choice for apartments and narrow living rooms. It comes in four widths, from a 2-seater to the 4-seater Major.
UPHOLSTERY
 Fabric (categories A and B) or leather (C and D). You can also send your own fabric or leather (C.O.M. / C.O.L.).

fichas.h1_agente: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.h1_seo: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Hermes Maxi is an upholstered king bed by DV Home Collection, built on a multilayer structure padded with non-deformable polyurethane foam. Made in Italy.

HEADBOARD AND QUILTING

The Hermes bed has a large headboard with vertical quilting.

UPHOLSTERY AND CUSHIONS

  • Fabric: a wide range of options.
  • Leather: a wide range of options.
  • Goose feather square decorative cushions, available on request.

Because the cushions come on request, decide at the time of order whether you want them with this maxi bed. See our king beds for other upholstered frames.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Hermes bed frame pairs a low upholstered base with an extra-wide headboard in vertical quilting. The "Maxi" is the wide version of the Hermes Bed: the headboard runs well past the sides of the mattress.
BEFORE YOU ORDER
 It fits a standard American King mattress (76 3/4" × 80"). Slats are included and the mattress is not. Measure the wall first: this maxi bed is much wider than the mattress.
UPHOLSTERY
 Fabrics from the Lario, Lido, Cloud and Vegan Nabuk lines, or leather in categories A, B and C. Square goose feather cushions (19 5/8" or 15 3/4") are available on request.

fichas.h1_agente: Tiffany Multilayered Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection
fichas.h1_seo: Tiffany Large Rectangular Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Tiffany is a multilayered wall mirror by DV Home Collection. This Italian mirror has a natural mirror glass and a frame in six finishes. Made in Italy.

FRAME FINISHES

The frame is the only choice; the mirror glass stays the same across all versions. Among Tiffany mirrors, choose stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black, or 24Kt gold.

Browse all wall mirrors.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Tiffany mirror is a rectangular wall mirror with a slim metal frame and natural mirror glass, 1/8" thick. Made in Italy.
VERTICAL OR HORIZONTAL
 You can hang it upright, or turn it sideways over a console or a sideboard. For a taller, narrower mirror, see the Tiffany Extra Large.
FRAME FINISHES
 Stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black, 24kt gold, champagne gold, pink gold or gold satin.

fichas.h1_agente: Cleopatra Wood and Leather Dining Chair by OAK
fichas.h1_seo: Cleopatra Wood and Leather Dining Chair by OAK
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The cleopatra chair design by OAK pairs a wooden frame with leather upholstery. This wood and leather chair is made for the dining room in three wood finishes.

THREE WOOD FINISHES

  • Rosewood
  • Ebony
  • Citronier

The cleopatra wooden chair is the same model in all three, so the wood is the decision: match it to your dining table.

See all dining chairs and armchairs at Cassoni.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
Designed by Luca Scacchetti, Cleopatra's chair is a wood and leather chair for the dining room. It has a tall backrest that stands out around the table.
WOOD
 This Cleopatra wooden chair comes in amara ebony, or lacquered in black, ivory, lead grey, red or white. Each option has a satin or a polished finish.
LEATHER
 Smooth leather in categories A to C, waxed leather or nabuk, including a nabuk with a Kuba pattern.

fichas.h1_agente: Cruise Teak Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
fichas.h1_seo: Cruise Teak Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Cruise is a three-seater outdoor sofa from Talenti. This Talenti sofa has a structure entirely in teak wood, synthetic rope on the armrests and backrest, and weather-resistant cushions. Made in Italy.

TEAK AND ROPE

The frame is teak wood and the rope on the armrests and backrest is synthetic, so this outdoor couch takes sun and rain without covers.

SEATS THREE

Cushions are made with weather-resistant fabrics. The Cruise couch is the three-seater of the Cruise teak collection, sized for outdoor living areas; browse all outdoor sofas for other layouts.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
The Cruise couch is a three-seater outdoor sofa by Ludovica + Roberto Palomba for Talenti. It has a full teak frame, with woven synthetic rope on the arms and backrest, like the deck of a boat.
MADE TO STAY OUTSIDE
 • Smoke teak frame.
 • Quick-dry foam padding.
 • Removable cushion covers in weather-resistant, fire-rated outdoor fabrics (Mambo Taupe, Twill Beige, Slate Grey).
A LOW, RELAXED SEAT
 The seat is 14 5/8" high, lower than an indoor sofa, for lounging by the pool or on a terrace. Extra decorative cushions are optional.

fichas.h1_agente: Bakkarat Glass Dining Table by Tonelli Design
fichas.h1_seo: Bakkarat Round Glass Dining Table by Tonelli Design
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Bakkarat is an Italian table in extra clear glass by Tonelli Design. The glass slab top contrasts with the round top and the sculptural central leg, which rest on a chrome-plated metal base. Made in Italy.

GLASS AND CHROME

  • Extra clear glass slab top.
  • Round top and sculptural central leg.
  • Chrome-plated metal base.

The clear top keeps the chrome base and the sculptural leg visible from every seat, so this glass table shows its structure. It is a dining table for a room where the base is the design. See all dining tables.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
A round dining table in glass by D'Urbino e Lomazzi for Tonelli. The top is extra clear tempered glass. The sculptural central leg is a 1 1/8" thick glass piece on a polished chrome base. Made in Italy.
WHY EXTRA CLEAR GLASS
 Standard glass shows a green tint at the edges. Extra clear glass stays colorless, so this glass table lets you see the twist of the leg from every side of the room.
FOUR DIAMETERS
 From 43 1/4" to 55 1/8", all at standard dining height.

fichas.h1_agente: Illan Wood Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.h1_seo: Illan LED Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Illan lamp is a wood wall sconce designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath for Luceplan. Its shade is laser-cut layered wood; the die-cast aluminum body holds an LED source that casts light upward. Made in Italy.

The Luceplan Illan shade is cut from surplus material left over from the Illan suspension lamp.

SHADE AND LIGHT

  • Laser-cut, layered wood shade, ultra-thin and flexible.
  • LED 21W, 1265 lm, 2700K or 3000K, CRI 90, dimmable.
  • UL Approved, built to National Electrical Code requirements.

Pick 2700K for a warmer glow or 3000K for neutral white; both are dimmable. Wall-mounted, this wood sconce keeps the floor clear. For more wall sconces, browse the category.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
Luceplan Illan is an LED wall sconce designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath. Its shade is laser-cut birch wood in thin layers, made from the material left over when producing the Illan suspension lamp.
THE LIGHT
 • LED 21W, 1265 lumens, CRI 90.
 • Dimmable, in 2700K (warmer) or 3000K.
 • The light points upward, so this wall light washes the wall without glare.
 • UL approved.
WHERE IT WORKS
 At 11" wide and only 5 1/8" deep, it fits hallways and both sides of a bed.

fichas.h1_agente: Steinway Mother-of-Pearl Piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte
fichas.h1_seo: Hand-Carved Mother-of-Pearl Steinway Piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The 19800 Steinway piano is a Riva Mobili D'Arte piano with hand-carved base and sides and mother-of-pearl inlays across the surface. Made in Italy.

CARVING AND INLAY

  • Hand-carved decorations run along the base and sides.
  • Mother-of-pearl inlays reflect light in iridescent shades.

This mother of pearl piano is a Steinway and Sons piano made by Riva Mobili D'Arte. As an italian piano, it is a piece to place where its carved base and inlaid surface can be seen up close. See all pianos.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
Among Steinway and Sons pianos, this is a one-of-a-kind dressed piece. Riva Mobili d'Arte covers it in mother-of-pearl, with inlays of precious wood and brass and a deep high-gloss finish. The result is an Italian piano case made to be the centerpiece of a room.
CRAFT
 A solid wood base, hand-carved in three dimensions and finished in hand-applied gold leaf. The mother-of-pearl changes color with the angle of light. A matching ottoman is included.
MATCHING PIECES
 The same finish is available on sofas, lounge chairs, consoles and mirrors from the collection.

fichas.h1_seo: Shibari Stretch Fabric Armchair by Visionnaire
fichas.descripcion_agente:
The Shibari is a Visionnaire armchair with a continuous, enveloping silhouette, covered entirely in stretch fabric. Curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest and form a fluid knot, so structure and shape read as one piece.

THE KNOT

The knot is an intertwined connection, not a restraint. It is what sets Shibari chairs apart, and it holds the legs and the backrest together.

COVER AND CORE

This fabric armchair pairs the stretch cover with a high-density polyurethane core and a webbed seat for support. Shibari furniture by Visionnaire stays light to the eye and solid in use. See our armchairs.
fichas.descripcion_seo:
A Visionnaire chair designed by Studiopepe. Curved metal tubes run from the legs to the backrest, where they close in a soft knot, the idea behind the name.
UPHOLSTERY
 Fully covered in recycled stretch fabric (Paddington) in Chalk, Carbon, Natural, Amaretto or Gris, with a backrest cushion included. Like all Shibari chairs, it has a high-density foam core and a webbed seat.
